guia.what: A surface container for grouping related content. It comes with `ts card-media` (an image) and a card group (`data-card-grid`, a responsive layout), and it can be made clickable as an `<a class="ts card is-link" href>`.
whenUse: The content reads as a unit, like a product, a project, or a summary.
Each item has a different shape (image, text, actions) and doesn’t fit in a row.
You want the block to stand out from the background and be clickable as a whole.
whenAvoid: The items are uniform and compared field by field → `table`.
You only need to separate blocks of text → `separator` or whitespace.
dos: If the whole card is clickable, make it an `<a class="ts card is-link" href>` instead of adding an invisible button.
Keep the same structure across all the cards in a grid.
donts: Don’t nest cards inside cards. The hierarchy gets lost.
Don’t add several different actions to a card that’s already a link as a whole.

nucleo: The spotlight effect follows the pointer, and Core handles that. Listens to `pointermove` and writes two CSS variables with the position. Without it, the Card still looks right, just without the glow.
